about_the_game:
Defend your home planet from hordes of creatures in this Atari styled roguelite!

Protect your home planet ZRAGG from the evil rival planet ZROGG, getting stronger and stronger as time progresses to match the numbers of ZROGG's army. 

This Game Features:

  • Standard Play: Fight through 3 levels that progressively get harder and harder, protecting your planet until you defeat King ZROGG!

  • Endless Play: Rack up as much score as you can until you're overwhelmed by ZROGG inhabitants!

  • Tutorial Play: Learn tips and tricks about the game's Items, and playable characters! 

  • 4 Unique Playable Characters with different play styles! Unlocked by beating Standard mode!

  • An Original Soundtrack composed by LandonThePancake, ThatGuyGZ, & Techsec.

  • And other various shenanigans!

and with that being said,

Zragg on.
